---
title: "Governance"
lang: en
---

The EMPRESS Research Network is governed by three bodies &mdash; the Steering Committee, the Coordinating Committee, and the Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) &mdash; supported by a project manager. The roles are clearly defined and mutually balanced to safeguard scientific integrity and participant safety.

## Steering Committee {#steering}

**Responsibilities**: provide scientific direction; approve the protocol and important amendments; oversee overall study progress; make final decisions on key scientific issues (including sample size re-estimation and blinded data reviews).

## Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) {#dsmb}

**Responsibilities**: independent of the study team, periodically review safety and efficacy data; assess benefit-risk against prespecified boundaries; advise the Steering Committee to continue, modify, or stop the study. Board members are not involved in study conduct.

| Name | Institution | Role |
|:---|:---|:---:|
| Ignacio Martin-Loeches | Ireland | Chair |
| Longxiang Su | Peking Union Medical College Hospital | Member |
| Xiaobo Yang | Union Hospital, Tongji Medical College, Huazhong University of Science and Technology (Wuhan Union) | Member |

**Member profiles**

<ul class="bio-list">
  <li><span class="bio-name">Ignacio Martin-Loeches</span> Professor of intensive care medicine, St James's Hospital / Trinity College Dublin, Ireland; authority on severe infection and respiratory critical care; contributor to international consensus statements including the SCCM/ESICM definition of refractory septic shock.</li>
  <li><span class="bio-name">Longxiang Su</span> Department of Critical Care Medicine, Peking Union Medical College Hospital; research interests include tissue perfusion monitoring in circulatory shock and critical care informatics (e.g., tissue oxygen saturation and lactate clearance, large language models in critical care).</li>
  <li><span class="bio-name">Xiaobo Yang</span> Department of Critical Care Medicine, Union Hospital, Tongji Medical College, Huazhong University of Science and Technology (Wuhan Union); research interests include sepsis and severe infection (viral sepsis, pneumonia in immunocompromised hosts).</li>
</ul>
